responsePromise: Quote back within a few hours, seven days a week.

process.detail: Room sizes and a photo of where the outdoor unit could go is usually enough for a guide price.
Power, pipe runs and where it will actually be quiet. Then a fixed price in writing.
Most single splits are a morning. We test it, show you the controller and clean up.

faq.a: Room size, ceiling height, insulation and which way the windows face all matter. An undersized unit runs flat out and costs more to run, so we size it properly rather than guessing.
Splits are cheaper per room and easy to retrofit. Ducted looks tidier and suits whole houses. We will tell you where the break-even sits for your place.
A single split is usually a morning. Ducted is a few days.

faq.q: Do you service what you install?
faq.a: Yes, and we will tell you honestly when a repair is not worth it.
